endpoint_source: new run ReDirector Stage2 native final frame
temporal_transform: first N consecutive actual source frames, no repeated or interpolated input frames
spatial_transform: aspect-preserving resize and black letterbox to 840x480; model native portrait support not claimed
prompt: At the fixed new camera viewpoint shown by the supplied Stage 2 terminal frame, continue the exact order of subject and object actions from the supplied source video after the highlight frame. Maintain the same subject's identity, appearance, pose continuity, background geometry and lighting. The camera must stay stationary at this new viewpoint. Do not keep the action frozen, invent different motion, change the subject, move the camera, or rebuild the scene.
official_reference_condition: RV2V ref_image + experimental first-chunk VAE endpoint latent pin
compatibility: isolated unfused torch norm/RoPE; eager VAE; official weights unchanged
endpoint_resize: official JoyAI bicubic stretch to 840x480 in VAE; supplied original native endpoint file retained
source_transport: JPEG quality95 over official WebSocket; lossless_chunks means no dropped source frames, not pixel-lossless JPEG
